dashboard.where: Mobile menu drawer: nav item linking to the home dashboard

setlists.where: Desktop header nav link and mobile menu drawer item: the list of setlists
setlists.context: setlist = the ordered list of songs for a service

schedule.where: Desktop header nav link, mobile tab bar button (label and accessible label) and mobile menu item: the musicians' schedule page

library.where: Desktop header nav link and mobile menu item: the chart library

monitor.where: Desktop header nav link, mobile tab bar button and mobile menu item: the wedge monitor mixer
monitor.context: monitor = the wedge (stage monitor) mixer, not a computer screen

settings.where: Desktop user menu item and mobile menu item: the Settings page

manage.where: Desktop user menu item and mobile menu item: the band leaders' management console

platform.where: Desktop user menu item and mobile menu item: the platform owner's console

changelog.where: Mobile menu drawer item: the release notes page

offline.where: Desktop header: red pill badge shown when the device has no network

searchSongsPlaceholder.where: Desktop header and mobile tab bar: placeholder of the song search box

searchSongs.where: Desktop header and mobile tab bar: accessible label of the song search box and search button

searchTab.where: Mobile tab bar: label under the search button

noSongsFound.where: Mobile tab bar search popover: shown when the search matches no chart

openSetlist.where: Mobile tab bar: accessible label of the central setlist button (opens the current or next setlist in Perform mode)

setlistTab.where: Mobile tab bar: label under the central setlist button

userMenu.where: Desktop header: accessible label of the avatar button that opens the user menu

profilePhotoAlt.where: Desktop header and mobile menu: alt text of the user's profile photo

musicianFallback.where: Desktop user menu and mobile menu header: shown instead of the user's name when they have none

pendingRole.where: Desktop user menu: small uppercase role line when the user has no role yet

roleCode.admin.where: Desktop user menu: small uppercase line naming the user's role (English shows the raw role code)

roleCode.bandLeader.where: Desktop user menu: small uppercase line naming the user's role (English shows the raw role code)

roleCode.musician.where: Desktop user menu: small uppercase line naming the user's role (English shows the raw role code)

roleCode.member.where: Desktop user menu: small uppercase line naming the user's role (English shows the raw role code)

roleCode.pending.where: Desktop user menu: small uppercase line naming the user's role (English shows the raw role code)

roleCode.denied.where: Desktop user menu: small uppercase line naming the user's role (English shows the raw role code)

roleBadge.admin.where: Mobile menu drawer: small all-caps badge naming the user's role

roleBadge.bandLeader.where: Mobile menu drawer: small all-caps badge naming the user's role

roleBadge.musician.where: Mobile menu drawer: small all-caps badge naming the user's role

roleBadge.member.where: Mobile menu drawer: small all-caps badge naming the user's role (also the fallback for unknown roles)

roleBadge.pending.where: Mobile menu drawer: small all-caps badge naming the user's role

signIn.where: Desktop header: sign-in button for visitors

openMenu.where: Mobile header: accessible label of the hamburger button

versionLine.where: Mobile menu drawer footer: tiny app version line
versionLine.context: {version} is the app version number, {commit} a short code commit id

notifications.where: Header bell button accessible label and the notifications dropdown heading

markAllRead.where: Notifications dropdown: link that marks every notification read

justNow.where: Notifications dropdown: age of a notification under a minute old

minutesAgo.where: Notifications dropdown: compact age of a notification
minutesAgo.context: {minutes} is a number of minutes; 'm' = minutes, keep it compact

hoursAgo.where: Notifications dropdown: compact age of a notification
hoursAgo.context: {hours} is a number of hours; 'h' = hours, keep it compact

daysAgo.where: Notifications dropdown: compact age of a notification
daysAgo.context: {days} is a number of days; 'd' = days, keep it compact

orgLogoAlt.where: Header and login page: alt text of the congregation's or band's logo
orgLogoAlt.context: {orgName} is the congregation's or band's name
